integrity_notes: The universal complete-bipartite claim is proved by spectral projectors and explicit positive factorizations. The P4 threshold is proved from exact rational entries and a one-sign-change quartic; finite exact computations are supplementary checks only.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight connected simple undirected graphs only; no weighted-graph generalization is claimed.
The statement concerns the exact one-step rational end map, not internal Runge--Kutta stages or floating-point sign preservation.
Only the complete bipartite family and the sharp P4 boundary are classified; no all-graph classification is asserted.
title: Complete bipartite random walks are unconditionally positive under fourth-order diagonal Padé stepping
